parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity, GRCs still issued, gender-reassignment discrimination protection survives the 2025 ruling, care is available, and society shows broad (if LGB-not-trans-specific) tolerance with large LGBT communities. But the dossier documents tier-1 state-imposed universal exposures with no working remedy shown: statutory single-sex-space code (Aug 2026) excluding trans people from changing rooms, hostels and medical services; planned ward bans, with a documented death after bed removal; strip-search and custody placement by birth sex; and a court striking down trans-protective prison guidance. These reach every outed visitor via institutions she cannot talk her way out of. Rule of law enforces the hostile policy, so it compounds rather than mitigates. Hostile media trajectory and partial hate-crime coverage add weight; absence of violence/border friction caps the score here.
